coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No city-specific open parcel scope verified in this research pass. Country-level evidence is not attributed to this urban centre.
coverageAssessment.finding: Coordinates resolve to Dongjiao Town (东峤镇), Xiuyu District, Putian City, Fujian, rather than an unspecified similarly named locality. Official provincial/city material documents land and real-estate registration and local land administration; no anonymous parcel polygon endpoint with stable native parcel key was verified. Registration/service visibility is not equivalent to downloadable geometry. Follow-up inspected the official provincial TianDiTu portal and municipal Putian geospatial program. They expose public base-map/vector/imagery geoinformation, and Putian maintains its own public geospatial platform; no cadastral parcel layer or stable parcel ID was identified. The official Putian bureau/municipal map host timed out in direct requests, so this is a source discovery lead with endpoint inspection incomplete.

nextStep: When Putian/Fujian map hosts are reachable, inspect public app service configuration/catalogue and any cadastral or land thematic layers; test only a tiny Dongjiao viewport for polygons with permanent parcel IDs. Current evidence confirms public mapping platforms and imagery/vector basemaps only.
registryBasis: Official Dongjiao land and real-estate registration evidence. Public mapping platforms found; no anonymous parcel polygon endpoint verified.
